referenceFunction.generalComment: The functional unit represents 1 m2 of a 6-layer FR-4 PWB, Pb-free surface finished (mixture of different finishing methods), with soldermask, for surface mount applications, without mounted components. It is designed to be used in ICT applications. Process data are taken from environmental reports of 3 German PWB producers, plus from literature. The described PWB has a square weight of 3.26 kg/m2. An update was made in 2023, comprising: modification to energy consumption and regionalization of inventory flows, such as energy and metal input (Duque Ciceri et al., 2010; Kupka et al., 2018.); Geography: This module is based on information from European producers that are seen as representative for the global situation.; UUID: b748c7f6-1878-3ab5-857f-b4af0ee1457b
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module covers the assembly of a PWB prepared for surface mounting of components. In this dataset (raw) materials, infrastructure, energy consumption, emissions to air and water and waste amounts from the production of 1 m2 of board are taken into account. Not included into this dataset is the mounting of the PWB.

technology.text: Dataset comprises the following steps of PWB production: substrate preparation, imaging, exposure, etching, sandwiching, activation and accelaration steps as well as copper plating, cleaning, oxidification, dry vacuum lamination, micro etching, surface finishing.
